description: This Kotlin source file defines a benchmark test class for measuring scroll performance of a 'For You' feed in an Android application. It uses the Android Benchmark library to run repeated scrolling tests with different compilation modes, including setup routines to launch the app before testing.

classes.name: ScrollForYouFeedBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class that measures scrolling performance of the 'For You' feed in the Android app using different compilation modes.

methods.name: scrollFeedCompilationNone
methods.description: Runs the scroll feed benchmark with no compilation optimizations (CompilationMode.None()).

methods.name: scrollFeedCompilationBaselineProfile
methods.description: Runs the scroll feed benchmark with partial compilation profiling (CompilationMode.Partial()).

methods.name: scrollFeedCompilationFull
methods.description: Runs the scroll feed benchmark with full compilation optimization (CompilationMode.Full()).

methods.name: scrollFeed
methods.description: Performs the actual measurement of scrolling performance, setting up app launch and executing scroll actions repeatedly.
